'''Cheapside Cantina''', also known as the '''Bestine Cantina''', was a [[Cantina/Legends|cantina]] in the [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Bestine (city)/Legends|Bestine]] on the [[Desert/Legends|desert]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]].
